name: Introductory Biology
summary: A first tour of the living world: what life is, how cells work, how traits are inherited, how species evolve and how ecosystems fit together.

topics.name: Biology as a science: the unifying themes of the life sciences
Characteristics of life: organisation, metabolism, homeostasis, growth, reproduction, response, evolution
Levels of biological organisation from molecules to the biosphere
Basic chemistry of life: atoms, water and the four classes of biological molecules
Cell theory, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, and the main organelles
Energy in living things: an overview of photosynthesis and cellular respiration
Cell division: mitosis and meiosis at a glance
Heredity basics: genes, alleles, dominance and Mendel's laws
From DNA to protein: the central dogma in outline
Evolution basics: variation, natural selection, adaptation and common descent
The diversity of life: three domains and the major kingdoms
Organism basics: how plants and animals are built and kept alive
Ecosystems basics: food chains, energy flow, nutrient cycles and biomes
Humans and the biosphere: biodiversity loss, disease and biotechnology in everyday life
